MORE:
In terms of the provisions of Regulation 30 and Regulation 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligation & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform that the Board of Director of the Company at its meeting held today i.e., November 05, 2026, inter alia has:

1. Approval of Unaudited Financial Results.
2. Reappointment of Chief Executive Officer "Mr. Prakash Sahu".

The Board Meeting commenced at 03.15 PM and concluded at 4.00 PM.
